title: Eleven Minutes in a Cold Room
subtitle: 咨询与协商 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 咨询与协商（社会服务与人际沟通·咨询与协商）
meta: 主题语境：咨询与协商（社会服务与人际沟通·咨询与协商）　|　核心词汇：consultation　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 consultation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 my mother ① held a consultation in a room that had eleven chairs and one heater, and she said the holding was the whole of the deciding. The ② consultation, meaning the meeting and not the advice, lasted forty minutes and stayed that length; consultation, she said, is the only thing in a cold room that is judged by how many chairs are filled.

Every ③ consultation in that clinic had the same form at the door, and the ④ consultation at the end, meaning the one she kept for the difficult cases and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever prepared for twice. Consultation, my grandmother said, is nine parts preparing and one part somebody willing to listen; my mother said the listening is the part that fills the forty minutes.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ consultation was the whole of the letter, meaning the referring and not the meeting. The ⑥ consultation, meaning the referring and not any of that, is the only thing in a letter that everybody mentions and nobody does; consultation, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both a meeting and a referring. She said the referring is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ consultation had become a line in a rota, and the rota had become an argument about the form. The ⑧ consultation of the whole thing, my mother wrote in November, was one room and thirty years of listening; consultation, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to prepare. He said the preparing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ consultation I remember is the one at the end, which was held in 1982 and is still described as the fullest in the county. A ⑩ consultation, my grandmother said in 1984, is the only thing that improves by being prepared for; every consultation, she said, is a referring that has agreed to look like a meeting. She said the referring was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 会诊（指那场会面本身，与那些建议相对）
C. 固定搭配：hold a consultation 举行一次会诊／商议
D. n. 会诊（指那家诊所里每一次）
E. n. 会诊（指末尾那一次）
F. n. 查阅；参考（指信里提到的查阅）
G. n. 会诊（指排班表里提到的那一次）
H. n. 协商；磋商（抽象总称）

items.q: held a consultation in a room that had eleven chairs
The consultation, meaning the meeting and not the advice
consultation was the whole of the letter
the consultation had become a line in a rota
The consultation of the whole thing
A consultation, my grandmother said in 1984

answers.why: hold a consultation 意为“举行一次会诊／商议”，1968 年母亲在一间有十一把椅子、一个取暖器的屋子里举行了一次会诊。
consultation 意为“会诊、会面”，指那场会面本身而不是那些建议，它持续了四十分钟。
consultation 指那家诊所里每一次会诊，每一次门口都放着同样的表格。
consultation 指末尾那一次（她留给疑难病例的那一次），是唯一有人准备过两次的。
consultation 意为“查阅、参考”，父亲说查阅就是那封信的全部，指的是查证而不是那场会面。
consultation 为另一个义项，指信里的查阅参考而不是那场会面，是信里人人都提到、却无人去做的事。
consultation 意为“会诊”，指排班表里提到的那一次，到 1976 年这次会诊成了排班表里的一行。
consultation 意为“协商、磋商”，母亲十一月写道，整件事的磋商是一间屋子三十年的倾听。
consultation 意为“咨询、会诊”，我记得的是末尾那一次，1982 年举行，至今仍被说成全县人最齐的。
consultation 为抽象总称，祖母说一次会诊是唯一会因为被认真准备而变好的东西。
